svg.title: Processing PII with Presidio — Implementation detail
svg.desc: Implementation components and six-step flow, within the target AWS private network. The .NET worker embeds CPython through Python.NET and passes plain field values to local Presidio. Complete producer-specific binary codecs and live MQ transport are pending. TXT diagnostics and raw BIN inputs retain their representation. Output is atomically delivered before deletion. Two fictional passengers share unchanged PNR K7QX2M and receive irreversible shared labels with no tokens or JSON.
svg.text: Receive → parse entire file → anonymize locally → rebuild → deliver → delete input
AWS customer private network · target environment; EC2 / ECS selection pending
Current implementation: local folder feeds + embedded Presidio. No deployed AWS service or live MQ connection.
Example fields only; vendor layout unconfirmed.
Opaque binary data remains with the codec.
PNR stays K7QX2M; replacements are labels.
Own codec + FeedPolicy · independent feed worker
BinaryFeedInput checks MQ dump offsets and byte count.
Extract named fields + field locations; retain original layout.
Known: full span; Analyze: configured entities + threshold.
Keep bypasses Python; Replace / Mask / Redact use Presidio.
Plain values + policy args; shared engines gated per field.
Recompute byte lengths / padding / counts for changed values.
Preserve PNR, passenger grouping and unaffected binary data.
TXT: preserve diagnostic representation; BIN: raw payload.
MQMD is separate; native MQ adapter must handle it.
Only then Acknowledge deletes the claimed source file.
The final output is the rebuilt, validated anonymized file.
Any failure → retain the whole input
Failure marker prevents automatic reprocessing after restart.
Correct the cause, then resubmit as a new delivery.
config/feed-policies.xml · validate at startup; restart to apply.
Known structured field → force span; skip NLP detection.
Analyze free text → entity allowlist + confidence threshold.
Keep / Replace / Mask / Redact · unknown field rejects input.
One worker per feed; shared Presidio serialized per field.
Field actions, fast/slow feed isolation and delivery/deletion verified using a test-only binary codec.
Complete airline payload + producer codec; real IBM MQ adapter using native clients; AWS deployment.
No JSON conversion or tokenization. Shared replacement labels; no recovery map. PNR remains visible.
Supplied capture: 560 / 920 bytes → rejected. Illustrative fields above do not define the airline binary schema.
